# Blacksmith

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-28c4468da5d86f40"></a>

## Become a Blacksmith

In Loguetown's sword shop Zoro tossed the cursed Sandai Kitetsu into the air and let it fall past his arm. The shopkeeper gave him a second sword for free.

Choose Blacksmith as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Blacksmith

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Blacksmith XP +300

<a id="q-1518058803b56eec"></a>

## Apprentice Blacksmith

Every famous blade was once a lump of steel on somebody's anvil.

Reach Blacksmith level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Blacksmith](blacksmith.md#q-28c4468da5d86f40)

**Tasks**

- Reach Blacksmith level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Blacksmith XP +800

<a id="q-11da53262ebb624f"></a>

## Journeyman Blacksmith

Loguetown's sword shop has armed rookies since Roger's day. Forge a katana worthy of its racks.

Reach Blacksmith level 25, Forge a Katana and land on a harbour town in your home Blue.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Blacksmith](blacksmith.md#q-1518058803b56eec)

**Tasks**

- Reach Blacksmith level 25
- Forge a Katana
- Land on a harbour town in your home Blue

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Blacksmith XP +3,000

<a id="q-7eb1bbb7de87f35b"></a>

## Expert Blacksmith

Wano's smiths made Enma and Ame no Habakiri. Their secrets include Soul Solid and bullets of sea-prism stone.

Reach Blacksmith level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Blacksmith](blacksmith.md#q-11da53262ebb624f)

**Tasks**

- Reach Blacksmith level 50
- Forge the Soul Solid
- Forge Kairoseki Bullets
- Land on Wano Country

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Blacksmith XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-2a0285907f95ae35"></a>

## Master Blacksmith

Wano honours one swordsmith above all others. Earn that title.

Reach Blacksmith level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Blacksmith](blacksmith.md#q-7eb1bbb7de87f35b)

**Tasks**

- Reach Blacksmith level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
